title: Helps me focus
body: I love this app. The only downside is that it often crashes when I'm trying to sync it with my ipad.
author: Dyokat

title: App Crashed on Offline mode
body:
When I went into offline mode of this app, it stopped going into offline mode forever, it would just prompt me a video to watch and then say the video is unavailable had to Undownload it and re-download it…hopefully I haven’t lost my gardens🧍‍♂️
I write this not to tell you download the app but to help the developers to hopefully identify and debug their app because it’s a great app.🙏
author: youngtman

title: Super cute!
body:
I love how motivating this mini game is! Other than the fact that it is very crowed, the feeling is relaxing! I just think someone options should be free (I know creators need to make a profit, I’m just saying). 

Overall, I would definitely recommend for young learners to keep motivated to study and focus without using the phone. Love this app! ❤️❤️❤️😊
author: PrettyPixelated

title: Great app
body: Love love the app. Helps me concentrate on my work and nit go on my phone. The game is super fun
